approved-update.replay: a second admission of the same valid approval (v1 or v2) in the same server process yields mutation_approval_consumed, with no provider I/O
approved-update.missingApprovalFile: with [external_token.mutation] configured and no mutation_approval_file, the server refuses to start: target_configuration_invalid
approved-update.readsV2: while valid/update-feature-v2.json is active (expiresAt > now), GET /partstudios/d/{d}/w/{claimed workspaceId}/e/{e}/features and /documents/d/{d}/w/{claimed workspaceId}/currentmicroversion are admitted in addition to the configured read target

mcp-tools.json: exact match against the external-token tools/list output, in order

mutation-context.valid/update-feature.json: equal to executionContext output (ignoring expiresAt); apiCall validates against mcp-tools.json onshape_api_call inputSchema

boundsV2._comment: Static mutation bounds for v2 fixtures (no workspace, feature or microversion pins). With the v1 'target' pins configured instead (expand step), every v2 fixture yields the same result, because its claims equal those pins.

boundsGoal._comment: Static bounds plus goal configuration for goal-grant fixtures (§12.1). No approval v2 file is active unless a case says so.

goal-grant._comment: Each case: grant fixture + request fixture (goal-grant/requests) + empty journal unless stated → expected code or 'admitted' (= reaches §12.3 step 11 and dispatches once). Order of §12.3 applies.

behaviour.twoChangesOneGoal: with valid/active.json and an empty journal: update-depth (2xx) then update-fillet-radius (2xx) are both admitted; journal has sequences 1 and 2 with outcome OK; no second confirmation or grant revision is needed
behaviour.budget: with valid/active.json modified to maxDispatches 2 and journal entries 1 OK, 2 PROVIDER_REJECTED: the next request yields goal_budget_exhausted; an entry with outcome NOT_DISPATCHED does not count
behaviour.duplicate: after update-depth was dispatched with outcome OK, the identical request (same requestHash) yields goal_dispatch_duplicate with no provider I/O
behaviour.uncertain: a dispatch ending in transport error/timeout/5xx/3xx/408 yields mutation_outcome_unknown_reconcile_required with data {goalId, sequence, featureId, sourceMicroversion, admittedAt}; the next request yields goal_reconciliation_required until the grant has reconciledThrough >= that sequence (valid/reconciled-through-1.json unblocks sequence 1)
behaviour.restart: a journal whose last line for sequence 1 is PENDING is loaded after a restart as UNCERTAIN: the next request yields goal_reconciliation_required; the budget counts sequence 1
behaviour.stopRace: if the grant file changes to valid/stopped.json between §12.3 step 9 and step 11, the server records NOT_DISPATCHED for the new sequence, makes no provider call and returns goal_grant_stopped
behaviour.authorityConflict: with valid/active.json and approved-update/valid/update-feature-v2.json both present and unexpired, any mutation yields mutation_authority_conflict
behaviour.nullGrantFallsBack: with goal-grant.json = null, mutations follow §2.5 unchanged (approval v2 fixtures keep their results)
behaviour.journalUnavailable: a journal directory with group/other bits, a foreign owner or a corrupt line yields dispatch_journal_unavailable with no provider I/O
behaviour.missingJournalDir: goal_grant_file configured without dispatch_journal_dir: the server refuses to start with target_configuration_invalid
behaviour.readsGoal: while valid/active.json or valid/stopped.json exists and is unexpired, GETs of /documents/d/{d}/w/{grant workspaceId}/currentmicroversion, /documents/d/{d}/w/{grant workspaceId}/elements and /partstudios/d/{d}/w/{grant workspaceId}/e/{e}/features are admitted
behaviour.reconciledBeyondJournal: a grant with reconciledThrough greater than the highest journal sequence (e.g. valid/reconciled-through-1.json against an empty journal) yields goal_grant_invalid
behaviour.journalSummary: after twoChangesOneGoal, GET /goals/{goalId}/journal-summary returns entries 2, counted 2, maxSequence 2, unreconciledSequence null, unreconciledEntry null, lastOutcome OK
behaviour.journalSummaryUncertain: after update-depth with valid/active.json ends in HTTP 503 (admittedAt 4102444600000), GET /goals/{goalId}/journal-summary equals goal-grant/journal-summary/uncertain.json with requestHash replaced by the computed value; with valid/reconciled-through-1.json, unreconciledSequence and unreconciledEntry are null

capabilities.approval-v2-and-goal.json: server with mutation_approval_file, goal_grant_file and a valid dispatch_journal_dir
capabilities.404: pre-1.1.0 server; plugin reports goal path UNSUPPORTED

goal-workflow.goal-hash/vector.json: TS: goalHash(scope) equals goalHash and canonical(scope) equals canonical
goal-workflow.goal-view/active.json: TS: GoalView projection of an ACTIVE goal after two OK dispatches has exactly these keys and types (values volatile except structure)
